newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gas find fires up Santos shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gas find fires up Santos shares.

text.p: Santos Ltd's shares jumped 15 cents or 3.0 percent in active early Tuesday trade after the oil and gas producer announced late on Monday it had found another oil and gas field in Queensland.
Brokers said the new field and the announcement earlier on Monday of Santos' purchase of MIM Holdings Ltd's oil and gas assets were Santos' main drivers in what was a flat market overall.
"It's building up quite a bit of momentum," Shaw Stockbroking dealer Paul Ford said.
"Obviously, they've done a few things there with buying MIM's oil and gas assets and they're getting a good portfolio together," Ford said.
"That (the gas find) is the major factor," another Sydney dealer said.

Santos said the discovery was in Queensland's Authority To Permit (ATP) 259P. A gas flow rate of 203,338 cubic metres or 7.18 million cubic feet per day was recorded in a drill stem test on in the Patchwarra formation.
Santos is the operator of the south-west Queensland joint venture with a 58.8625 percent interest.

Other partners in the well are Boral Ltd unit Boral Energy with 16.5 percent, Exxon Corp unit Delhi Petroleum with 23.2 percent, Australian Hydrocarbons Ltd with 1.2 percent, and Oil Company of Australia Ltd with 0.2375 percent.
MIM Holdings Ltd said on Monday it has sold its oil and gas business to Santos Ltd for A$45.1 million.
